environment.description: Pipeline plugin deployed on EC2 instance (m5.large) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in us-east-1. NLB operates at Layer 4 (TCP passthrough) with no inspection capabilities. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 10.0.0.0/8 (internal VPC CIDR). The application runs as 'pipeline-worker' user with access to Docker socket and build tools. No request body inspection or content filtering is applied at any layer.

config.network: Private subnet, accessible from internal VPC
